_about: M3-ENV-01 post-import rules for the Tamsule Bell kit (game/core/import/tamsule_bell_kit_post_import.gd, AssetImportRules), the same contract as haluna_kit.json: each glTF material slot maps to the .tres of the same name, and every authored <piece>-lod1 chain gets the LodChain ranges. LOD0 holds longer than Haluna's because the arena's ring pieces are 30-40 m across and are composed from 150 m (tamsule_bell.md T01). No -col proxies yet: m2-slice builds walk collision for the zone.
